basics.name: Ahmed Ashour
basics.label: Senior Product Designer
basics.headline: Engineering-trained product designer · Design systems · 10+ years shipping SaaS, mobile and e-commerce products
basics.summary: I studied Electronics & Communications Engineering, so I design the way an engineer thinks: start with constraints, trace the failure modes, then build the system. Over 10+ years I've taken three B2B SaaS products from 0→1, co-built a Figma-native design system used across three engineering squads, and built and led a UX team while still designing hands-on every day.
basics.targets: Senior & Lead Product Designer roles · Saudi Arabia & Gulf · Remote Europe · Egypt

work.name: Intouch
work.position: Senior Product Designer · Head of UX
work.summary: Retail media platform that turns retailers' in-store screens, audio and signage into an advertising network, live across 61,000+ media points on three continents. Joined as the sole designer and grew into Head of UX, owning design across the full product suite.
highlights: Led design and delivery of 3 core B2B SaaS products from 0→1, now live for retailers across Europe, Latin America and MENA (incl. Saudi Arabia and UAE).
Co-built Intouch's design system with Figma Variables, Auto Layout and a 44-component library, reducing handoff friction and UI bug reports across 3 engineering squads.
Drove a 40% improvement in user retention through a data-informed redesign of core flows, validated with usability testing and product analytics.
Built and led the UX team: design process, critique cadence and cross-functional workflow with PMs and engineers in Agile.
Owned design strategy for mobile and web, from discovery and problem framing through IA, interaction design and Figma Dev Mode handoff.

work.name: Inmobly
work.summary: Product studio building consumer and enterprise mobile apps for clients across MENA and Europe.
highlights: Redesigned UX flows for 6+ consumer mobile apps using Jobs-to-be-Done framing and iterative usability testing, improving task completion and reducing onboarding drop-off.
Built and maintained design systems for client products (reusable components, brand tokens, pattern libraries), cutting production time across projects.
Ran the UX process end to end: research, journey mapping, wireframes, high-fidelity Figma prototypes and direct client design reviews.
Moved the team's handoff from Zeplin to Figma-native annotations, working closely with front-end engineers on implementation accuracy.
Mentored junior designers and shaped the team's critique and iteration culture.

work.name: Freelance & contract
work.summary: Client work alongside full-time roles, for Nodens (B2B) and Smardex (fintech).
highlights: Designed a custom CRM interface on Odoo for Nodens, balancing functional complexity with usable UI patterns.
Delivered brand systems, campaign assets, reusable UI components and After Effects motion assets for web and mobile marketing.
